The SELFIES decode to methyl 6-(dimethylcarbamoyl)nicotinate becoming 6-(dimethylcarbamoyl)nicotinic acid. The change is methyl-ester hydrolysis; the dimethylamide and heteroaromatic ring remain intact.

An analogous ORD record supports LiOH in water/THF for the saponification. The record also lists toluene and HCl, consistent with acidification during workup, but does not establish the exact workup sequence. Evidence: `call_yzc7CQa4BSf5gc0OfXlE4914`.
